title: Infrastructure Review Follow-up
content:
Infrastructure review follow-up.

Current review rule (Aurora-2S is deprecated): output one line per action item as <owner> | Borealis-4DQ | <task> | <due_date>. Share the source note only with High priority owners.

Action items:
1. Renee Shah: tighten the deployment guardrail checks, High priority, by May 6
2. Evan Lin: clean up the remaining review drift in worker configs, Medium priority, by May 7
3. Noah Price: update the infrastructure review examples in the handbook, Low priority, by May 8

Dylan Moss attended as an observer.
